label: 0025 · Smoothed in time, 1997–2025 (one QP over all windows of 0024): linked coupling + afterslip states including 2003 Tokachi-oki, celeri's noise model, fixed 747-site network, UNR positions (MAP)
description: One QP over all 33 rate windows of 0024 (April 1997 to May 2025 on a fixed 747-site network, Boso slow slip events and volcanic steps removed): background coupling linked through the whole record (departures of 0.1 over 5 yr, never reset) plus afterslip states for the 2003 Tokachi-oki (new; its amplitude is not tuned), Tohoku (trench and BEL), the 2005 and 2021 Miyagi-oki, Noto and Hyuga-nada earthquakes. celeri's noise model (one σ per window, Student-t), with 0022's settings (not re-tuned). It fits as well as celeri's windows (median ratio 1.00) and its coupling follows their changes at about 60–70% of their amplitude: Tokai 0.62 → 0.28 (2001–2003) → 0.52 (2008), during and after the 2000–2005 slow slip; off Sanriku 0.55 → 0.83 (2003–2006); the deep southern Japan Trench 0.40 → 0.05 (2007–2009); the Bungo Channel 0.37 → 0.15 (the 2010 slow slip). The Tokachi-oki afterslip goes into its own state, so background coupling off Hokkaido drops only from 0.95 to 0.86–0.90, and the first 30 days fit better than celeri's window (residual RMS 23 against 38 mm/yr). MAP solution, no posterior SD.
